name: The Starblood Stalkers
inspire: After your opponent's Power step, if your warband holds 3 or more treasure tokens, Inspire each friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Skink Agility
reactions.flavorText: Dexterous and nimble, the skinks of the Starblood Stalkers are capable of slipping away from danger with remarkable speed.
reactions.rulesText: Immediately after you make a Save roll as part of a melee Attack for a friendly Skink ({icon:skink}) with no Charge tokens in friendly territory, you can re-roll 1 Save dice in that Save roll.

abilities.name: The Diviner
abilities.flavorText: Kixi-Taka's cosmic powers allow him to foresee potential reward - or call down heavenly doom.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a feature token within 3 hexes of your leader ({icon:leader}). Either flip that feature token or inflict 1 damage on an enemy fighter on or adjacent to that feature token. This ability can only be used once per battle round.

abilities.name: The Bulwark Celestial
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: These most resolute of cosmic conjunctions infuse the Seraphon with a similarly firm endurance.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters cannot be driven back until the end of the battle round or until any player uses an Asterism ({icon:asterism}) ability. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: The Great Drake
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Ascendant constellations of almighty Dracothion grant the Starblood Stalkers' weapons a cosmic power.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters' melee weapons have +1 Attack dice until the end of the battle round or until any player uses an Asterism ({icon:asterism}) ability. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: The Hunter's Steed
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: As the stars of the steed rise to dominate the heavens, predatory speed infuses the Stalkers.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters have +1 Move until the end of the battle round or until any player uses an Asterism ({icon:asterism}) ability. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five Seraphon skinks backed by a hard-hitting Kroxigor, with most fighters on 2 Health and relying on rerollable Saves in friendly territory. Nearly every skink carries a short-range ranged attack, letting the warband pepper foes from a distance while Klaq-Trok's cleaving blows handle tough targets. Kixi-Taka manipulates feature tokens, flipping them or zapping nearby enemies, and once-per-game Asterism powers grant extra Move, melee dice or immunity to drive-backs. The warband wins by snatching and holding treasure, inspiring every fighter once three tokens are secured.
